items.headline: FMRB executive order classified-annex deadline expires inside the day
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's sixth calendar day rolls to Friday's seventh, with the Friday May 22 deadline now reaching its expiry inside the day itself rather than sitting one calendar day out. Thursday's five-of-eight witness count steps to eight of eight on record as the three remaining witnesses — NSA Director, FBI Cyber Division Assistant Director, and OMB Federal CIO — all file substantive responses during the Friday morning intake window, clearing the last open procedural gate at T-zero with the eight-witness slate complete inside the deadline window. Just Security observes the eight-of-eight close inside the deadline window itself is the cleanest reading of the response curve the eight-witness slate could have produced, and White House OSTP shifts its posture from Thursday's 'no signing before May 22' line to 'signing window open from end-of-day May 22 forward' as the post-deadline session opens. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee holds its Thursday-locked Wednesday May 27 markup slot and circulates a Friday-morning supplemental staff memorandum covering the now-closed Senate classified-annex record as the first formal House-track context document since the order's signing window opened.

items.headline: Cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter recasts US recognition-gap horizon
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's sixteen-named-candidate count holds at sixteen on Friday as OECD GENAI secretariat-reported member-state delegations enter the second business day of the working-procedure review on the draft Recommendation text, with the secretariat circulating a Friday addendum capturing Thursday's plenary-prep agenda items. The plenary target steps from T-minus-twelve to T-minus-eleven calendar days and T-minus-seven business days against the June 2-6 adoption window. Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window crosses its second-week close into its third week (from second-week midpoint), no third Gulf Cooperation Council member yet signals, and the cohort treats the now-eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close on the United States side as the first concrete signal that the FMRB executive order signing window can in fact open inside the OECD plenary's June 2-6 horizon — converting the United States recognition-gap closure from a forward-looking question into a near-term plenary-window arithmetic.

items.headline: n8n CVE-2026-21858 exposure opens first full post-deadline operating day
items.diff_narrative: The day-twenty-one Thursday scan rolls to day-twenty-two Friday — the first full post-deadline operating day rather than the deadline day itself. Internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances fall from roughly 980 to roughly 830 — the first sub-900 reading of the descent — and the residual unpatched long-tail share eases from about 7 percent to about 6 percent. The US cohort eases from roughly 290 to roughly 245 and India from roughly 150 to roughly 130 as the federal-civilian remediation deadline transitions from intake into its compliance-monitoring phase. Censys exploitation telemetry steps down from 1.5x baseline to approximately 1.3x baseline — the first sub-1.5x weekday read in the descent. CISA's compliance-monitoring phase opens cleanly with the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits compliance window keyed to Friday May 22 now reaching T-zero and converting into a settled regulatory precedent, with the mandatory-attestation submission portal in its first operating day post-deadline logging a small Friday-morning batch of late-attestation submissions ahead of the formal compliance-window close.

items.headline: MCP-server attack-surface visibility holds above 93 percent for second day
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's business-week-fourth-day cadence carries into Friday's pre-weekend cadence with each consecutive-day counter ticking up one. The credential-extraction median holds at 5 minutes for an eleventh consecutive day (from a tenth), with the unprotected-versus-protected gap tightening from near 66x to near 64x as Defender-protected detection latency moves from 5.5 to 5.3 hours. Defender-for-Cloud quarantine on net-new MCP servers ticks from 52 percent to 54 percent — a twelfth consecutive day of expansion (from an eleventh) and the third consecutive day above the half-of-net-new threshold. Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy edges from roughly 2,525 to roughly 2,560 enterprise tenants and Akamai SkyAtlas MCP-firewall from roughly 1,450 to roughly 1,470, with CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI's managed-visibility composition nudging from 93 percent to 94 percent — a one-point uptick keeping the line above the 93-percent threshold for a second consecutive day and the highest cross-vendor visibility reading the telemetry has carried — and the total exposed-server estimate easing from roughly 8,790 to roughly 8,690.

items.headline: Loader-verification line opens RC1 cycle on doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's fully-cleared-regulatory-anchor framing rolls to Friday's doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop as the federal civilian directive transitions into its compliance-monitoring phase at T-zero on the May 22 compliance window and the FMRB classified-annex record closes eight-of-eight inside the same Friday session. The five-document academic reference set sits atop both a CISA operational precedent in compliance-monitoring mode and a now-eligible-to-sign executive instrument, giving the upstream framework cohort the cleanest alignment story the loader-verification line has produced and converting the mid-June default-shipment commitment from a downhill release into a release-cycle execution detail. The LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort opens the formal mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle with a Friday-morning RC1 branch cut on each project's main, covering all six verification surfaces — and the DeepMind/Meta AI/Anthropic/Microsoft consolidated index ships a Friday-morning supplementary tag bundling Thursday's arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion alongside Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey as the canonical two-paper deployment reference.

items.headline: Mag-7 print cycle reads canonical first post-analyst-day session
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's Alphabet analyst-day inflection converts on Friday into the canonical first post-event reaction session, with the desk preview cohort now treating Friday morning as the cleanest read on how the AI Services revenue-line breakout commitment prices into the Mag-7 follow-on print cycle ahead of the weekend close. The Bernstein-Wells Fargo-Evercore ISI-Citi Research-Jefferies-Goldman Sachs preview cohort consensus steps the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability from Thursday's 96 percent to 97 percent — the highest reading the cohort has carried and the first reading inside one percentage point of unanimity — with the Friday cohort treating the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the canonical disclosure-precedent document set rather than the prior Friday SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter alone. On the AI-accelerator IPO track, Tenstorrent's Corp Fin review advances from a 14-business-day mark to a 15-business-day mark — three full business weeks since the first-round response — with the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval after Thursday's late-morning landing and the early-August public-filing target firmed against the now-cleaned regulatory environment.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS settles fourth consecutive trading session in upper analyst band
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's post-analyst-day re-rating session carries on Friday into a fourth consecutive trading session of upper-half-of-analyst-band settling on the pre-weekend tape. The five-desk analyst spread tightens one notch further upward: Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor still holds, Morgan Stanley's $192 target carries an upside-scenario probability stepping from Thursday's 51 percent to 54 percent inside its first full session above the half-probability threshold, Wells Fargo Securities Buy lifts from $215 to $220, Jefferies Outperform holds at $225, and UBS Neutral lifts from $212 to $215. Institutional-buyside cumulative net position edges from roughly 42 percent to roughly 44 percent of float as desks added incremental long exposure on the post-event reaction tape, with the cohort flagging the cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close as a second-order regulatory-anchor input compounding the cross-program allocation commentary. The Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close advances from the final third into the closing third of its late-Q2 2026 window, and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion moves into the leading edge of the 10-21 day execution window's final stretch.

items.headline: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 reaches 74 gated tenants four days ahead
items.diff_narrative: Day fourteen rolls to day fifteen with the second-week growth normalization settling into a third consecutive sub-5-percent day — published skills rise from roughly 35,900 to roughly 37,300 (+3.9 percent, a ninth consecutive sub-7-percent reading and the third sub-5-percent day of the second week), skill installs from roughly 3.04M to roughly 3.11M, and auto-quarantined Mythos-class skills from 75 to 77. The gated-tenant cohort extends Thursday's weekday cadence into a tenth consecutive weekday-and-rotation: two further enterprise customers join to lift the Mythos-Preview count from 72 to 74, with both new entrants in the Continental European public-sector tier as the cohort rotates back from Thursday's North American financial-services additions and Wednesday's Continental European public-sector layer. The verification harness now executes the six-document end-to-end conformance run alongside the standard cross-tenant audit — confirming the demonstration cycle scales cleanly through the sixth surface as the loader-verification line composes its full settled reference set. The Decoder notes the seventy-four-tenant mark was reached four business days ahead of the cohort's projected window (from three).

items.headline: Mistral AI Workflows reaches twelve central-government references
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's eleventh central-government reference (Norway Skatteetaten) rolls to Friday's twelfth — and the first twelve-reference reading the day-counter has carried — as Switzerland's Federal Tax Administration joins as the first European Free Trade Association entrant to the cohort, the fifth fresh central-government estate selection of the business week. Paid Workflows tenancy edges from roughly 423 to roughly 431 enterprise customers and daily executions from roughly 7.7M to roughly 7.8M. The six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix enters the final week before its first-week-of-June general-availability target with the GA-readiness checklist clearing its final third entering the pre-GA week, and the conformance test suite now runs the six-document end-to-end conformance run as a fourth confirmation pass holding green across all six vendors for a fifth consecutive weekday with no schema-drift regression.

items.headline: OpenAI per-org agent registry extends to thirteenth Indo-Pacific region
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's twelve-region Indo-Pacific GA footprint rolls to Friday's thirteenth region as Taiwan secondary cloud region joins (after Hong Kong on Thursday, Philippines on Wednesday, Thailand on Tuesday, and Malaysia on Monday), the fifth regional extension of the business week. GA-cohort tenancy edges from roughly 371 to roughly 379 enterprise customers, and OpenAI ships a Codex CLI v3.1.9 development-branch tag — two minor patches on top of Thursday's v3.1.8 — adding optional client-side support for Thursday's arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion alongside the consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run as the canonical two-paper conformance reference ahead of the early-June cross-orchestrator interop matrix GA target. The cohort reads the Taiwan secondary region addition as continuing to track the sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter rather than expand ahead of it, with Brunei now the sole Indo-Pacific named-candidate outside the GA footprint and that addition expected to land alongside the OECD plenary window.

items.headline: Unsloth closes business week with three stable 60B-class MoE recipes
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's roughly 0.3 percent peak combined VRAM tightening on the refined Mixture-of-Experts router-only LoRA path gets a further roughly 0.25 percent peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe on the same single-node octa-Hopper run, attributed to a router-attention bucket-fusion micro-pass refinement on top of Thursday's layer-norm bucket-fusion. Unsloth continues to carry the full six-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage and now executes the canonical two-paper conformance reference run (Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey plus Thursday's 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion) as an eighth validation pass on every training-driver invocation (up from Thursday's seventh-pass single-paper run). The DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe draws a thirteenth Hacker News reproduction (from a twelfth), and a fifth contributor merges the Mixtral-Next 70B MoE port from a Thursday pull request as a stable contributed recipe alongside the OLMo-2 60B MoE and Qwen3 MoE 60B ports — closing the business week with three stable contributed 60B-class recipes for the first time since the program opened.

items.headline: vLLM v0.11.4 stable cites canonical two-paper conformance reference
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's third full operating day rolls to Friday's fourth with no escalations from the maintainer cohort. The Yotta Labs throughput gap tightens further: from about 1.8 percent on Thursday to about 1.65 percent on Friday — about 19,310 tok/s on v0.11.4 stable versus about 19,630 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.9, the tightest sustained band the benchmark has carried in the descent — with Cloudflare Infire holding L40S edge-tier parity at 1.00x into the fifth day post-stable. The v0.11.5 development branch now folds Thursday's arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion in as the eighth verification step alongside the existing seven-step coverage, with Hugging Face TGI v3.2.2 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.9 carrying the full set as the serving-stack reference build for the mid-June framework default-shipment window. The cohort treats Friday's transition of the federal-civilian directive into compliance-monitoring mode as the regulatory-anchor settle-state confirmation day on which the v0.11.4 stable tag plus the cleared CISA directive plus the canonical two-paper conformance reference can all be cited together as a single coherent stable-and-cleared reference for the upstream framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle that opened the same Friday morning.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Galaxy rack shipments reach 80 percent of capacity target
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's weekday cadence carries into Friday with a fresh batch lifting the cumulative count from roughly 211 to roughly 223 racks against the 280-rack first-half target — about 80 percent fulfilled (up from about 75 percent, a five-point uptick and the highest fulfillment reading the curve has carried). Additions span CoreWeave and Lambda Labs in North America plus a fifth Asia-Pacific increment splitting between Yotta Labs India and SK Cloud Korea plus a fifth European sovereign-cloud increment going to Cloud Sigma Switzerland and Scaleway France on top of Thursday's Open Telekom Cloud Germany plus Aruba Cloud Italy and Wednesday's Outscale France plus Atlante Cloud Italy. AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book advances from near 10.95GW to near 11.1GW with a fresh weekday sovereign-cloud commitment — the fifth new commitment of the business week and the first time the book has cleared the 11GW mark, converting the 11GW threshold from a forward-looking target into a settled landmark — and the Tenstorrent confidential S-1 holds its early-August public-filing target firmly cited as a revenue-traction anchor against a now-doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop.

items.headline: Cerebras CS-4 plus Vera Rubin plus AMD Helios book fresh AWS plus Aramco allocations
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's post-analyst-day Alphabet allocation read converts on Friday into a second-allocation post-event reaction read, with all three accelerator tracks confirming engineering-sample windows hold and a second fresh allocation surfacing across each track. Cerebras's four-batch schedule still places first-batch engineering samples to lead customer OpenAI in mid-Q1 2027, but a second Mythos-Preview-tier allocation has landed for Amazon Web Services' Bedrock enterprise-AI program inside the third engineering-sample batch window, joining Thursday's Alphabet allocation, as the Friday post-event reaction session surfaced the second cross-program allocation the desk preview cohort had flagged as the inflection bar. Nvidia's four shipped NVL576 engineering-sample batches hold their Thursday allocations across the OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Apple, Mistral AI, xAI, Microsoft Azure, and Alphabet cohorts, with a fresh Friday allocation to Amazon Web Services ahead of the late-Q1 2027 production-volume window. AMD's first MI450 Helios production-rack samples to SoftBank Cloud Japan and SK Telecom Cloud Korea plus the NTT Data, Naver Cloud, and Reliance Jio Cloud India tier are extended on Friday by a fresh allocation to Aramco Digital Saudi Arabia — the program's first Middle East allocation and a coincident input with the Aramco MoU close advancing into its closing third.

items.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 activates twelfth Fremont cohort, crosses 60 percent
items.diff_narrative: Thursday's eleventh cohort rolls to Friday's twelfth: a fresh cohort of roughly twelve units comes online, lifting the active count from 132 to 144 of the disclosed 240-unit allocation — 60 percent reached (up from 55 percent) — with cycle-time still holding at the roughly 1.03x human-baseline envelope and the cumulative onboarding window now tracking four days ahead of the original projected curve (from three). The twelfth cohort enters the Fremont automotive line on the same multi-station sealed parts-transfer chain that has been the standard cohort-onboarding workflow since the eighth-cohort activation, with cross-cell coordination on the eleventh-cohort line continuing without incident through its second day of operation and the eighth-through-tenth-cohort lines all holding their cycle-time envelopes into the pre-weekend close. The Stellantis Detroit (June 8) and Volkswagen Wolfsburg (June 22) activation dates hold, and Standard Bots firms Thursday's first-week-of-June pull-forward as the expected completion of the disclosed 240-unit allocation if the weekday cadence holds.

items.headline: Boston Dynamics Atlas clears 192-hour milestone, runs toward 216-hour
items.diff_narrative: BMW Group's Spartanburg 30-unit Atlas pilot clears Thursday's first North American 192-hour continuous-operation milestone — the longest continuous-operation milestone the BMW Spartanburg pilot has cleared and the first eight-day mark in the North American cohort — and now runs toward a first North American 216-hour milestone on the under-body conveyor task with zero MTBF-impacting incidents. Volkswagen Wolfsburg's Atlas pilot edges from roughly 95 to roughly 99 units on the body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task as the fifth weekday shift carries the business-week's expansion pattern through the pre-weekend close. The humanoid league-table OEM-adopter roster's flagged ninth adopter — Renault Group Cleon — moves from due-diligence to a signed 25-unit pilot commitment, lifting the roster from eight to nine and giving the cohort its third consecutive day with a new OEM signing. Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin rolling-mill cycle-time improvement holds near 5.3 percent for an eleventh consecutive within-band day (from a tenth at 5.2 percent) with a small one-tenth-of-a-percent tightening on top of Thursday's reading, and the policy-distillation pipeline now executes the canonical two-paper conformance reference run on every policy-update cycle.

items.headline: Friday arxiv 2605.08147 operator-side compliance-monitoring companion lands
items.diff_narrative: A fresh Friday arxiv release, 2605.08147, closes the business-week research cycle by adding an operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion to the now-doubly-cleared loader-verification reference set — extending Thursday's six-document set into a seven-document reference set. Positioned as a second applied-deployment companion rather than a fresh formal model, it applies the 2605.07891 consolidation-survey reference set plus Thursday's 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion to the n-of-eleven operator sample's compliance-monitoring telemetry from the directive's first post-deadline operating day, and reports per-operator attestation-event rates landing inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a third consecutive cross-section sample. Simon Willison characterizes the paper as the canonical operator-side close on the loader-verification line and observes that the timing — released the same business day as the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring phase opened and the FMRB classified-annex record cleared eight-of-eight — completes the seven-document reference set the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle can cite as a single coherent academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring end-to-end reference.
